text:
Maria: Morning — I'm drafting launch criteria for the new Inference Advisor (recommendations for batching, caching, quantization + eval-triggered alerts). Posting a concise list of proposed must-haves so we can agree and assign owners.
Ethan: +1. Quick engineering must-have: deterministic fallback path for any quant recommendation (so we never blind-deploy a broken quantized variant). Also we need a clear SLO for latency regression per-route.
Sana: Customer signals: they want per-model download/exportable config, a non-invasive opt-in for eval alerts, and a simple 'apply recommendation' UX in the console (one-click with preview).
Alex: Implementation notes from runtime side: we'll need new runtime flags and telemetry. Proposed flags:
```
--kv-cache-enabled=[on|off]
--batch-window-ms=50
--quant-profile=auto|fp16|int8
```
Also need a canary toggle to pin traffic to variant N.
Maria: Acceptance criteria (proposal):
- Accuracy regressions vs baseline eval set < 1% (per-customer eval suite)
- No more than 5% of requests experience >2x latency increase after applying recs
- Demoable console flow: show rec, preview token-cost estimate, and apply/rollback
- Eval-triggered alerts surfaced in Console and optionally pushed to Sentry/Slack
Ethan: Add rollout policy: canary 10% -> 50% -> 100% with automated rollback if eval metrics cross thresholds (we should codify thresholds). Also require synthetic canary runs every deploy.
Sana: Ops asks: migration doc + per-tenant opt-out flag; need explicit consent for auto-apply. Also telemetry: record model_version, quant_profile, batch_window_ms, and 'advice_applied' boolean.
Alex: I'll add telemetry events: "opt_advice_shown", "advice_applied", "eval_alert_fired", and a small schema for each. Also need an API endpoint for the console to fetch per-model recs.
DevExBot: Reminder: RFC template for product launches lives at https://redwood.internal/roadmaps/rfc-template — please attach the acceptance criteria and rollout plan.
Maria: Owners (proposal): @Alex -> runtime/telemetry, @Ethan -> eval harness + metrics, @Sana -> customer pilot + docs. Can each confirm by EOD? I'll produce a short checklist after confirmations.
Ethan: Confirmed. I'll start wiring the eval harness and add automated comparisons against baseline. Will open PR with test harness by Thursday.
Alex: Confirmed. I'll prototype runtime flags in a branch and add telemetry hooks. Will validate quant profiles don't break KV cache semantics.
Sana: Confirmed. I'll reach out to two pilot customers (Acme & Novu) for opt-in trials and prepare communications + support runbook.
Maria: Great. Next steps: I'll drop an RFC doc and a 1-page checklist. We should also schedule a 30-min sync next week to review first PRs. Thanks all :tada:
